definitions.name: RFID2

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: Product declares WS1850S and I2C address 0x28 with compatibility to the earlier RC522 Unit. Official UIFlow wrapper uses MFRC522 driver initialization, REQA/WUPA, anti-collision/select/authentication and card block operations.

registers.transfer: official pcd_read/write_register use raw 8-bit register addresses over I2C; no SPI-shift transformation

gaps: Product WS1850S identity conflicts with the linked schematic MFRC522 label; preserve the distinction.
Do not map a UID directly to a Python read_card_uid return; FIFO/command/IRQ/card protocol execution is required.
